corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward owns artillery damage during actual eastern contact. No ground operator is credited with blocking the flying enemy. Its kill must precede route exit.
Midnight clears eastern then western upper restraints in separate deployments. Operators never attack or block the civilian.
Steward clears eastern then western lower restraints. Spot intercepts pursuing hostiles; safe arrival is separately required.
Fang holds upper central; Lancet and Ansel heal. Returning Steward clears reachable armor.
Friston holds lower central with reachable Fang assistance. Lancet bridges early healing; Ansel sustains later pressure; returning Steward kills #34.
Midnight intercepts upper outer and receives Ansel only during extended-range windows.
Spot retains three-block lower interception, self-heals during skill and receives reachable Steward damage support. Healing pauses Spot's attacks.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central interception, conditional automatic DP, and reachable lower-central assistance.
Early central healing and deployment heal; permanent supplemental central healing.
Upper-outer interception and eastern upper roadblock damage.
Lower-outer interception; skill heals himself, Ansel and Steward.
Central and Steward healing; extended skill reaches Midnight.
Eastern artillery contact, eastern lower roadblock damage and lower-outer ranged support.
Post-artillery central armor clearance, including lower armor #34.
Western lower roadblock clearance after hostile clearance.
Western upper roadblock clearance after upper-outer hostile clearance.

formation_structure.artillery_budget: A base 470-ATK arts hit against 50 RES deals 235 before any supported talent modifier. The enhanced-hit cycle yields approximately 173 ideal sustained DPS before contact and competing targets. Roughly 75 seconds of exclusive equivalent contact are required for 13000 HP. Elapsed deployment time is not proof of sufficient contact.

economy.failure_interpretation: Absence of Fang's first grant is a survival/deployment/skill-execution dependency failure. Do not borrow future grants or interpret an unfunded Spot deployment as successful.
economy.first_medic_repair: Lancet deploys at frame 181 using natural DP only, before the first central trooper spawn. Ansel is no longer the opening's first available healer.

opening_deployments.balance_source: Natural income; no skill income required.
Natural income alone already funds this deployment; first Fang grant, if observed, remains available.
Natural income plus exactly one observed 6-DP Fang grant.
17 additional natural DP since Spot; no second Fang grant required.
18 additional natural DP since Ansel; no further skill income required.

economy.opening_ledger_basis: Credit only the first 6-DP Fang grant, conditional on Fang remaining alive and deployed through readiness. Later grants are deliberately excluded from the listed opening balances. Natural income uses frame/30. No opening refund is assumed.
economy.rotation_costs: Use the supplied prior inspected current-model unchanged-cost behavior: Steward 18, Midnight 16. Each redeployment follows more than 70 seconds off field. Refunds are credited only for successful living retreats; later deployments do not require them.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: The timeline is fixed. Handoff conditions are assertions, not executable conditional actions. An unmet assertion invalidates the dependent schedule; it does not authorize a replacement action or an action on an absent operator.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Lancet [2,5] UP covers Fang [3,5] and Friston [4,5]. Ansel [5,5] DOWN covers those central blockers, Lancet and Steward [5,6]; extended range reaches Midnight [1,5]. Spot [6,5] skill covers Spot, Ansel [5,5] and Steward [5,6]. Neither medic is credited with ordinary healing of Spot.
formation_structure.mortality_policy: No death is required or automatically disqualifying. A death can have absorbed damage or contributed blocking/output, but releases its blocked enemies, gives zero refund, removes subsequent actions on that deployment, and invalidates any unfulfilled duty. No death-dependent same-ID redeployment is encoded.
formation_structure.output_geometry: Midnight RIGHT reaches eastern upper roadblock [1,6]. Steward UP from [5,6] reaches eastern lower roadblock [6,6] and the eastern patrol around [5,7], but does not cover the entire eastern vertical patrol. Steward LEFT from [5,6] reaches both central interception positions. Final Steward [5,3] UP reaches [6,2]; final Midnight [1,3] LEFT reaches [1,2].
formation_structure.validation_status: UNSIMULATED; no tools, file mutations, stage simulation or external AI providers used.

formation_transitions.transition: Lancet establishes central healing before first hostile contact.
Midnight establishes upper-outer interception and upper eastern roadblock damage.
Spot establishes lower-outer interception before its first trooper crosses the blocking position; crossing time must be checked rather than inferred from a different opening.
Ansel takes primary central healing; Lancet remains supplemental.
Steward takes eastern lower roadblock and artillery output under Ansel, with periodic Spot reinforcement.
Steward withdraws only under the asserted artillery kill and cleared dangerous projectile queue.
Steward returns LEFT for both central armor queues.
Midnight leaves only after all upper-outer hostiles are dead; no later upper-outer spawns remain.
Steward leaves only after hostile clearance, including #34.
Midnight returns at the western upper roadblock.
Steward returns at the western lower roadblock; maintain observation until both protected arrivals.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the seven listed IDs; all have rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true. No reserve-mode units or aliases.
Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]]. Every DEPLOY has an integer [row,col] and cardinal direction.
Every deployment must have its fee at execution. No dead-source DP or dead-unit refund. Fang's first grant is explicitly conditional.
Lancet must deploy successfully at frame 181 and sustain the central interception until Ansel arrives. Its low throughput is a testable dependency, not assumed equivalence to Ansel.
Zero protected deaths and both expected protected targets reaching their objectives. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians; officer contact within 1.2 remains dangerous.
Kill artillery before its route exit and account for already-created projectiles. Withdrawal never erases a projectile or guarantees a safe replacement tile.
Before each retreat, its departing hostile responsibility must be completed or explicitly held by remaining deployed units. Only deployed units receive skills or retreats.
remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and exactly two protected arrivals. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Lancet must actually heal both central blockers when injured. Fang must survive its first DP grant. Spot must intercept the first lower trooper before it passes.

Ansel and Spot divide central versus adjacent artillery-splash recovery. Steward must clear the lower eastern roadblock and accumulate sufficient actual artillery damage. Verify officer #16 interception before the historical frame 4070 leak; that frame is a comparison checkpoint, not a universal deadline.
Central blockers retain all unresolved armor within capacity during Steward's redeployment gap. No invisible reserve or extra damage source is assumed.
Steward clears both central queues, including #34. Midnight retains upper interception until its asserted clearance handoff.
Complete western roadblock destruction and both protected arrivals. Continue beyond the illustrative horizon if arrival is pending; time alone never establishes acceptance.

skill_intents.intent: Supported automatic 6-DP grants only while alive and deployed. First readiness is approximately frame 570; observe the grant rather than counting an additional manual activation.
Deployment heal of 200 and ordinary single-target healing only; no active skill or invented healing priority.
Upper roadblock and outer-lane arts windows; allow 40 active plus over 70 inactive seconds between activations.
First self-healing bridge, then adjacent recovery for Ansel and Steward. Allow 25 active plus over 40 inactive seconds; do not credit dodge or damage while healing.
Central healing boost and temporary extension to Midnight. Allow 25 active plus over 35 inactive seconds. No probabilistic extra heal.
Automatic enhanced arts attacks and supported high-defense priority. No manual target-order command is assumed.

tactical_thesis: Replace Kroos with an early Lancet-2 medical bridge. Retain four independent ground interceptions, fund Ansel only after sufficient income actually exists, and combine Steward's lower-restraint/artillery damage with Spot's adjacent healing. This is a complete CURRENT_MODEL_CHECKABLE hypothesis, not a demonstrated WIN. The decisive risks are Lancet's opening throughput, survival under repeated artillery splash, and Steward's actual artillery contact before its exit.
